# @astrake/lumora-server (Full Agentic Reference & v0.9.0 Migration Guide)

This document contains the complete, code-audited specification for generating, maintaining, and migrating parent applications built on `@astrake/lumora-server` **v0.9.0**.

---

## 1. Complete Configuration Signature (`lumora.config.ts`)

```typescript
import type { Context } from "hono";

export interface SqlitePragmasConfig {
  journalMode?: "WAL" | "DELETE" | "TRUNCATE" | "PERSIST" | "MEMORY" | "OFF"; // default: "WAL" ("MEMORY" for :memory:)
  busyTimeoutMs?: number;       // default: 5000
  synchronous?: "OFF" | "NORMAL" | "FULL" | "EXTRA"; // default: "NORMAL"
  foreignKeys?: boolean;        // default: true
  cacheSizeKb?: number;         // default: -64000 (~64MB)
}

export interface JwtClaimMapping {
  subject?: string;   // default: "sub"
  roles?: string;     // default: "roles" (accepts string[] or single string)
  tenantId?: string;  // default: "tenant_id"
  scopes?: string[];  // e.g. ["companyId", "branchId", "projectId"]
}

export type LumoraAuthConfig = {
  protectedPaths?: string[];
  publicPaths?: string[];
  customClaims?: string[];
  afterVerify?: (ctx: {
    claims: Record<string, unknown>;
    token: string;
    db: LumoraDatabase;
    c: Context;
  }) => Promise<boolean> | boolean;
} & (
  | { mode: "disabled" } // Allowed in development/test ONLY; throws in production
  | { mode: "static"; token: string; header?: string }
  | {
      mode: "jwt";
      secret: string;
      refreshSecret?: string;
      issuer?: string;
      audience?: string;
      clockSkewSeconds?: number;
      claimMapping?: JwtClaimMapping;
    }
  | {
      mode: "custom";
      verify: (c: Context) => Promise<LumoraAuthResult | null> | LumoraAuthResult | null;
    }
);

export type LumoraDatabaseConfig =
  | {
      client: "sqlite";
      url: string;
      autoBackup?: boolean;
      maxRetainedBackups?: number;
      pragmas?: SqlitePragmasConfig;
      auditHashChain?: boolean;
      maxRows?: number;
      onMaxRows?: "throw" | "truncate" | "warn";
      statementTimeoutMs?: number;
    }
  | {
      client: "mysql";
      url: string;
      autoBackup?: boolean;
      auditHashChain?: boolean;
      maxRows?: number;
      onMaxRows?: "throw" | "truncate" | "warn";
      statementTimeoutMs?: number;
    }
  | {
      client: "postgresql";
      url: string;
      autoBackup?: boolean;
      auditHashChain?: boolean;
      pool?: { min?: number; max?: number; idleTimeout?: number };
      schema?: string;
      ssl?: boolean | { ca?: string; cert?: string; key?: string; rejectUnauthorized?: boolean };
      maxRows?: number;
      onMaxRows?: "throw" | "truncate" | "warn";
      statementTimeoutMs?: number;
    };

export interface LumoraConfig {
  name?: string;
  mode?: "development" | "production" | "test";
  server?: { host?: string; port?: number };
  api: { base: string; version: string };
  routes?: { dir?: string };
  resources?: DefineResourceResult[];
  auth?: LumoraAuthConfig;
  database: LumoraDatabaseConfig;
  docs?: { enabled?: boolean; path?: string; openApiPath?: string };
  realtime?: {
    enabled?: boolean;          // default: false
    sseSuffix?: string;         // default: "events"
    websocketSuffix?: string;   // default: "ws"
    heartbeatIntervalMs?: number; // default: 25000 (0 to disable)
    maxReplayBuffer?: number;   // default: 100
  };
  logging?: { level?: "silent" | "minimal" | "verbose" };
  upload?: { dir: string; maxFileSizeMb?: number; serveAt?: string };
  email?: LumoraEmailConfig;
  ai?: LumoraAIConfig;
  schedule?: LumoraScheduledTask[];
  migrations?: {
    dir?: string;
    mode?: "auto" | "strict" | "off";
    blockDestructive?: boolean; // default: true in production (blocks DROP TABLE, DROP COLUMN, TRUNCATE, DELETE FROM)
    allowDowngrade?: boolean;   // default: false in production
    embeddedFiles?: Record<string, string>;
  };
  auditHashChain?: boolean;
  rateLimit?: {
    enabled?: boolean;
    windowMs?: number;
    max?: number;
    store?: "memory" | "database";
  };
  multiTenancy?: {
    enabled?: boolean;
    tenantIdField?: string;
  };
}
```

## 2. Complete Resource Definition Options (`defineResource`)

```typescript
export interface DefineResourceInput {
  resource: string;
  table?: string;
  fields: Record<string, {
    type: "string" | "number" | "boolean" | "uuid" | "date" | "json" | "file" | "file[]";
    required?: boolean;
    default?: unknown;
    searchable?: boolean; // enables ?search=
    filterable?: boolean; // enables ?field= and __gt, __lt, __in, __neq, __like, __ilike
    sortable?: boolean;   // enables ?sort=field or ?sort=-field
    unique?: boolean;
    accept?: string[];    // for file / file[]
    maxSize?: string;     // e.g. "10MB"
    visibleTo?: string[]; // RBAC field-level redaction
    hidden?: boolean;     // excluded from SQL SELECT and GET responses
    readOnly?: boolean;   // stripped from POST/PUT/PATCH payloads
  }>;
  auth?: "inherit" | "public" | "protected";
  readOnly?: boolean;
  immutable?: boolean;
  excludeFields?: string[]; // omitted from SQL SELECT projection in list()
  updateMethod?: "PUT" | "PATCH" | "both";
  rateLimit?: { disabled?: boolean; windowMs?: number; max?: number };
  audit?: boolean | { enabled?: boolean; hashChain?: boolean };
  query?: {
    searchable?: string[];
    filterable?: string[];
    sortable?: string[];
    defaultSort?: string;
    defaultPageSize?: number;
    maxPageSize?: number;
  };
  computed?: Record<string, {
    type: "string" | "number" | "boolean" | "json";
    resolve: (record: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: { auth?: LumoraAuthResult; database: LumoraDatabase }) => Promise<unknown> | unknown;
  }>;
  relations?: Record<string, {
    resource: string;
    type: "belongsTo" | "hasMany";
    foreignKey: string;
  }>;
  export?: { csv?: boolean | { maxRows?: number } };
  permissions?: {
    roles?: Partial<Record<"GET" | "GET_ONE" | "POST" | "PUT" | "PATCH" | "DELETE" | "BULK" | "EXPORT", string[]>>;
    scope?: { field: string; claimKey?: string; allowUnscopedForRoles?: string[] };
    allow?: (ctx: PermissionContext) => Promise<boolean> | boolean;
    /** Enforced on GET /:id, PUT /:id, PATCH /:id, and DELETE /:id */
    allowRecord?: (auth: LumoraAuthResult, record: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<boolean> | boolean;
  };
  hooks?: {
    beforeCreate?: (ctx: ResourceHookContext) => Promise<Record<string, unknown>> | Record<string, unknown>;
    afterCreate?: (record: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<void> | void;
    beforeUpdate?: (ctx: ResourceHookContext) => Promise<Record<string, unknown>> | Record<string, unknown>;
    afterUpdate?: (record: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<void> | void;
    beforeDelete?: (ctx: ResourceHookContext) => Promise<void> | void;
    afterDelete?: (record: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<void> | void;
  };
  meta?: { label?: string; description?: string; icon?: string; group?: string };
}
```

---

## 3. Enterprise Capabilities in `v0.9.0` (`RFC-01` through `RFC-10`)

### RFC-01: Custom Auth, Dual-Token Rotation & Multi-Axis Claim Mapping
- **Custom Auth in Production:** Use `auth: { mode: "custom", verify: async (c) => ({ subject: "u1", strategy: "custom", token: "...", roles: ["admin"], scope: { tenant_id: "t1" } }) }` when your parent app uses session/TOTP/OAuth verification. Note: `auth: { mode: "disabled" }` is strictly blocked in `production`.
- **JWT Claim Mapping:** Map custom JWT payload keys into `LumoraAuthResult` without rewriting tokens:
  ```typescript
  auth: {
    mode: "jwt",
    secret: process.env.JWT_SECRET!,
    refreshSecret: process.env.JWT_REFRESH_SECRET,
    claimMapping: {
      subject: "userId",
      roles: "role",
      tenantId: "companyId",
      scopes: ["companyId", "branchId", "verticalId"]
    }
  }
  ```
- **Token Signing & Refresh Rotation Helpers:**
  ```typescript
  import { signLumoraJwt, rotateLumoraTokens } from "@astrake/lumora-server";

  const accessToken = await signLumoraJwt({ sub: "u1", roles: ["admin"] }, secret, { expiresInSeconds: 900 });
  const refreshToken = await signLumoraJwt({ sub: "u1", token_use: "refresh" }, refreshSecret, { expiresInSeconds: 604800 });
  const rotated = await rotateLumoraTokens(refreshToken, { secret, refreshSecret });
  ```

### RFC-02 & RFC-03: Enterprise SQLite Pragmas, Atomic `VACUUM INTO` Backups & Migration Guards
- **Automatic SQLite Pragmas:** File-based SQLite databases automatically apply `PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL`, `PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000`, `PRAGMA synchronous = NORMAL`, `PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON`, and `PRAGMA cache_size = -64000` on `connect()`, and run `PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)` on `close()`.
- **Atomic Pre-Migration Backup & Auto-Restore:** When `database.autoBackup: true` is enabled on SQLite, Lumora executes `VACUUM INTO` (falling back to file + `-wal`/`-shm` copy), prunes older backups via `maxRetainedBackups`, and automatically restores the pre-migration backup if any pending migration fails.
- **Migration Checksum & Destructive Guards:** `migrations.status()` verifies SHA-256 checksums for all applied migrations even when `pending.length === 0`. `blockDestructive: true` blocks `DROP TABLE`, `DROP COLUMN`, `TRUNCATE`, and `DELETE FROM`.

### RFC-04: Global Rate Limit Inheritance & Security Headers
- Sub-routers mounted via `lumora.mountModule(prefix, router, options)` automatically inherit global `config.rateLimit` when `config.rateLimit.enabled` is `true` (opt out per module with `{ rateLimit: false }` or `{ rateLimit: { disabled: true } }`).
- Rate-limited endpoints emit `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset`, and `Retry-After` (on `429`).
- All responses include `X-Request-Id`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, and `X-Frame-Options: DENY`.

### RFC-05: Cryptographic SHA-256 Hash-Chained Audit Ledger
- Enable globally (`auditHashChain: true` or `database.auditHashChain: true`), per resource (`audit: { hashChain: true }`), or per module (`mountModule(..., { audit: { hashChain: true } })`).
- Each `_audit_logs` record uses a monotonic UUIDv7 `id`, canonical sorted-key JSON (`canonicalJson`), `tenant_id`, `previous_hash` (`"GENESIS"` for the first entry in a tenant chain), and `chained_hash`.
- Verify integrity at any time:
  ```typescript
  const result = await lumora.database.verifyAuditChain("tenant-1");
  // { valid: true, checkedCount: 42 } or { valid: false, checkedCount: 12, brokenAtId: "...", expectedHash: "...", actualHash: "..." }
  ```

### RFC-06: Tenant-Isolated Realtime Channels, SSE Heartbeats & `Last-Event-ID` Replay
- Publish tenant-scoped events: `lumora.realtime.publishToTenant(tenantId, topic, payload)`.
- Create tenant-scoped SSE streams: `await lumora.realtime.createTenantSseResponse(tenantId, topic, c, options)`.
- Resource SSE (`/{resource}/events`) and WebSocket (`/{resource}/ws`) streams automatically isolate events by the subscriber's `tenantId` and `permissions.scope`.
- SSE connections emit `: ping\n\n` every `heartbeatIntervalMs` (default `25000ms`) and replay missed events from the ring buffer (`maxReplayBuffer`, default `100`) when `Last-Event-ID` header or `?lastEventId=` is supplied.

### RFC-07: Sub-Router OpenAPI 3.1.0 Introspection (`@hono/zod-openapi`)
- `@astrake/lumora-server` re-exports `OpenAPIHono`, `createRoute`, and `z` from `@hono/zod-openapi`.
- `lumora.mountModule(prefix, router, options)` automatically merges both `OpenAPIHono` specifications (`getOpenAPI31Document`) and standard Hono `router.routes` into `/__lumora/openapi.json`.
- `c.var.ok()`, `c.var.list()`, and `c.var.created()` return `Response & TypedResponse<...>`, so they typecheck directly inside `OpenAPIHono.openapi(route, (c) => c.var.ok(...))`.

### RFC-08: Composable Governance Middlewares
```typescript
import {
  OpenAPIHono,
  requirePolicy,
  enforceSoD,
  requireThreshold,
  requireTimeWindow,
  type LumoraHonoVariables
} from "@astrake/lumora-server";

const router = new OpenAPIHono<{ Variables: LumoraHonoVariables }>();

router.post(
  "/vouchers/:id/approve",
  requireTimeWindow(async (c) => ({ open: true })),
  enforceSoD(async (c) => c.req.header("x-creator-id")),
  requireThreshold({
    getValue: async (c) => Number(c.req.header("x-amount") ?? 0),
    tiers: [
      { maxAmount: 10_000, roles: ["manager"] },
      { maxAmount: 100_000, roles: ["director", "cfo"] }
    ]
  }),
  requirePolicy((principal) => principal.subject !== "suspended"),
  (c) => c.var.ok({ approved: true })
);
```

### RFC-09: Delta Sync (`?since=`) & Idempotency Middleware
- **Delta Sync:** `GET /{base}/{version}/{resource}?since=2026-10-18T00:00:00.000Z` filters `updated_at >= since`. `id`, `created_at`/`createdAt`, and `updated_at`/`updatedAt` are always filterable and sortable.
- **Idempotency Middleware:**
  ```typescript
  import { idempotency } from "@astrake/lumora-server";

  router.post("/payments", idempotency({ store: "database", required: true, ttlMs: 86_400_000 }), async (c) => {
    return c.var.created({ paymentId: "pay_123" });
  });
  ```
  Replays with the same `Idempotency-Key` and identical payload return the cached response with `X-Idempotency-Replayed: true`. Reusing a key with a different payload returns `409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`.

### RFC-10: Deep Readiness Probes, Prometheus Metrics & Graceful Shutdown
- **`GET /health` & `GET /__lumora/health`:** Runs `SELECT 1` against the active database and returns `{ ok, status: "healthy" | "degraded", name, version, resources, uptimeSeconds, database: { status, client, latencyMs } }` with HTTP `200` (or `503` if DB is unreachable).
- **`GET /__lumora/metrics`:** Returns JSON telemetry (`requestsTotal`, `errorsTotal`, `avgLatencyMs`, `statusCounts`, `uptimeSeconds`) or Prometheus text exposition format when `?format=prometheus` or `Accept: text/plain` is sent.
- **Graceful Shutdown:** `await lumora.stop()` (or `await lumora.shutdown()`) runs `onShutdown` hooks, drains in-flight cron tasks, closes active SSE/WebSocket streams, runs `PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)` on SQLite, and closes the DB pool.

---

## 4. Parent Application Migration Guide (`v0.8.10` → `v0.9.0`)

When upgrading a parent application from `@astrake/lumora-server@0.8.x` to `v0.9.0`, review these **10 code-audited behavioral changes**:

1. **`mountModule()` Rate-Limit Inheritance (`runtime.ts:1233-1248`):**
   - *Change:* Sub-routers mounted via `lumora.mountModule(path, router)` now automatically inherit global `config.rateLimit` when `config.rateLimit.enabled: true`.
   - *Migration:* If a mounted sub-router should **not** be rate-limited when global rate limiting is enabled, pass `{ rateLimit: false }` or `{ rateLimit: { disabled: true } }` to `mountModule()`.
2. **SQLite `PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON` & `WAL` by Default (`db.ts:360-377`):**
   - *Change:* SQLite connections now enable `PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON` and `PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL` automatically.
   - *Migration:* Ensure seed scripts and mutations insert parent rows before child rows, or opt out via `database: { client: "sqlite", url: "...", pragmas: { foreignKeys: false } }`.
3. **`permissions.allowRecord` Enforcement & `PUT`/`PATCH` Existence Check (`runtime.ts:871-885, 942-951, 1077-1082`):**
   - *Change:* `permissions.allowRecord(auth, record)` is now actively enforced on `GET /:id`, `PUT /:id`, `PATCH /:id`, and `DELETE /:id` (returning `403 Forbidden` when `false`). Also, `PUT`/`PATCH /:id` now checks record existence and returns `404` *before* running `hooks.beforeUpdate`.
   - *Migration:* Verify any existing `allowRecord` callbacks return `true` for authorized actors.
4. **`database.list()` Enforces `excludeFields`, `hidden`, and `multiTenancy` (`db.ts:219-228, 500-515`):**
   - *Change:* `database.list()` no longer runs `SELECT *`; it projects only non-hidden, non-excluded columns and automatically appends `WHERE tenant_id = ...` when `multiTenancy.enabled` and `db.tenantId` are set.
   - *Migration:* Remove any workarounds that manually stripped `excludeFields` after `database.list()`.
5. **Migration Checksum Verification in `status()` & `TRUNCATE` Blocking (`migrations.ts:80-95, 139-143`):**
   - *Change:* In `production` (`migrations.mode: "strict"`), `status()` now verifies SHA-256 checksums of all previously applied migrations even when `pending.length === 0`. `blockDestructive: true` now also blocks `TRUNCATE`.
   - *Migration:* Never edit already-applied `.sql` migration files; always add a new numbered `.sql` file.
6. **`GET /health` Executes Live DB `SELECT 1` Probe (`runtime.ts:1109-1137`):**
   - *Change:* `GET /health` (and `/__lumora/health`) queries `SELECT 1` and returns HTTP `503` if the database connection is down or closed.
   - *Migration:* In tests, call `GET /health` *before* calling `await lumora.close()`.
7. **OpenAPI `/events` and `/ws` Paths Gated on `realtime.enabled` (`docs.ts:31-38`):**
   - *Change:* `/__lumora/openapi.json` only includes `/{resource}/events` and `/{resource}/ws` when `realtime: { enabled: true }` is configured.
8. **Realtime SSE `id:` Prefix & Tenant/Scope Isolation (`realtime.ts:90-155`):**
   - *Change:* SSE frames now include `id: <seq>\n`, and resource SSE/WS streams filter out events from other tenants or scopes.
9. **Default Security Headers (`runtime.ts:500-502`):**
   - *Change:* Every response includes `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, and `X-Request-Id`.
   - *Migration:* If a custom route serves HTML intended for `<iframe>` embedding, overwrite `c.header("X-Frame-Options", "SAMEORIGIN")` in that route handler.
10. **Reserved `?since=` Query Parameter & `mountModule({ audit: true })` Action Values (`db.ts:138-151`, `runtime.ts:1260-1263`):**
    - *Change:* `?since=<ISO>` filters `updated_at >= since`. `mountModule({ audit: true })` logs normalized actions (`"create"`, `"update"`, `"delete"`) instead of raw HTTP verbs (`"POST"`, `"PUT"`, `"DELETE"`).
